accounting: One baseline model call, including invalid/refused response. No genome or random-weight position credit. Preserve exact raw response and provenance before any label read for scoring.
author_route: Parent authorized native Codex only; model/reasoning/thread/turn captured in actual response provenance.

baselines.host_inferred: Count input colors; rank by (-count,color); fill columns left-to-right and bottom-to-top, preserving grid shape. Frozen from training only; ties untested on demonstrations.

execution: Parse and compare data only. No authored Python, imports, model tools, downloads, API or remote access.

response_schema.predictions: Exactly one list of 1..30 digit strings, equal width 1..30; ASCII digits 0..9.

result_scope: Previously declared public-training search task. Development evidence; no held-out transfer, weight-learning or AGI claim.
selection: Freeze raw response before host-only exact query scoring; no retry or revision from query labels.
stop: STOP file, missing provenance, malformed response or one consumed attempt. No automatic call.
